name: @myelin/web
description: Myelin SolidStart app shell (E0.7 / MR-019): the running web app the whole UI hangs in — nav/routing, the ⌘K command palette, inbox, identity menu, residency cue — built on the MR-016 design-system + MR-017 overlays, fed by a REAL server-side cookie-auth gateway client that calls the MR-014/015 edge contract. The dev/test login is a clearly-marked seam the deferred OIDC login replaces. Wrapped by the MR-018 Tauri shell eventually (one Solid app, three shells).
